details:
Moonwalking with Minnie is an illustrated educational children's book designed for readers aged 8–10, developed as our solution to Challenge 1 of the NASA Space Apps Challenge. The project explores the human-made equipment, scientific instruments, and other objects left behind on the Moon during NASA's lunar missions. Through an imaginative journey with our original character, Minnie, we introduce young readers to lunar history and space exploration in a fun, accessible, and engaging way.

Our team independently developed the storyline, researched the subject, wrote the script, and created the illustrations. We used Canva for book design and layout, Adobe Illustrator for illustrations and visual elements, and Claude AI to support the creative development process.

The creative approach behind our project was to transform a scientific topic into a playful storytelling experience without compromising its educational value. We considered the target audience's age, reading comprehension, visual engagement, and ability to understand scientific concepts. By combining original character design, colorful illustrations, and simplified explanations, we aim to make space science more approachable, encourage curiosity, and inspire young readers to explore the wonders of space.
